resources.string: Its label and associated ratings or weight will be discarded. This cannot be undone.

Use 2–6 alternatives and 1–6 criteria. Labels must be nonblank single lines, at most 60 UTF-16 code units. Weights are whole numbers 0–100, with at least one positive weight; all ratings are whole numbers 0–5.

Higher ratings must mean better for every criterion. Re-express costs or risks as desirability before rating them. A zero-weight criterion has no effect. Each score is sum(weight × rating) divided by total weight, on a 0–5 scale.

This is an arithmetic summary of your judgments, not an objective answer, an AI recommendation or an assessment of people. Do not use it to determine eligibility or make high-impact decisions about people.
Ranks and ties use exact unrounded scores. Displayed means are rounded to four decimal places. Equal ranks are ties; numbering keeps the original alternative order within a tie.

Labels may contain private information. Automatic history and remembered results are off by default for this tool. Saving manually or enabling them stores content locally. Sharing sends the reviewed text to your selected app.
Explicit imports restore inputs only; press Compare alternatives. Remember results, if enabled, can reconstruct the last completed comparison. No labels or ratings are saved as mode preferences.
Set your criteria, weights and ratings, then compare.
